purpose: Freeze the post-closure algorithm-upgrade boundary before any new mechanism-specific empirical outcome is used. The contract protects the closed EOG-WF paper while allowing a separate v2 mechanism programme.

prediction_eligibility_v2.baseline_spatial_coordinate_overlap: warning requiring a response-independent redundancy audit; not by itself a biological exclusion rule
prediction_eligibility_v2.failure_effect: Layer A remains available; only default supervised Layer-B augmentation is withheld

source_symmetric_projection_v2_candidate.principle: retain exact source IDs in Layer A but aggregate prediction-facing support equally across the declared current source set before symmetric world summarization

mechanism_hypotheses.name: training_serving_generation_shift
mechanism_hypotheses.prediction: holding the underlying structural state fixed, matched feature generation should reduce train/serve representation discrepancy relative to leave-node-out training versus common-reconstruction serving

mechanism_hypotheses.name: static_node_signature
mechanism_hypotheses.prediction: a repeated-measure static representation can become a persistent node/spatial signature rather than a changing epistemic state; sequential refresh should reduce within-node constancy when evidence changes

mechanism_hypotheses.name: arbitrary_single_source_anchor
mechanism_hypotheses.prediction: lexicographic single-source projection can change under label renaming; source-symmetric v2 must remain numerically invariant to source order and label spelling

mechanism_hypotheses.name: world_set_saturation
mechanism_hypotheses.prediction: when the compatible world set never contracts, survival-fraction features provide no contraction signal; the system should report saturation rather than treating the feature block as evidence of dynamic world-set information

mechanism_hypotheses.name: fold_concentration
mechanism_hypotheses.prediction: outer-unit concentration may amplify an adverse macro score but is not a root-mechanism claim unless harm disappears outside the dominant unit

next_confirmatory_tests.phase_1: response-independent known-truth and invariance benchmarks for generator parity, state refresh, source label invariance and world-set saturation
next_confirmatory_tests.phase_2: only after phase_1 is frozen, a scientifically separate prospective mechanism experiment may compare matched static versus sequential state generation

forbidden: rerun Tampa with repaired features and relabel it independent
use Azores or Louisiana outcomes to tune v2 and then call the same endpoints prospective
claim sequential Layer B is generally beneficial from the two favorable endpoints
claim the Tampa harm mechanism is causally identified before a prospective mechanism test
